http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

def get_games_of_2019():
    """
    Returns a list of major sporting events that took place in 2019.
    Each event is represented as a dictionary with keys:
        - name: str
        - sport: str
        - date: str (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - location: str
    """
    return [
        {
            "name": "Super Bowl LIII",
            "sport": "American Football",
            "date": "2019-02-03",
            "location": "Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Atlanta"
        },
        {
            "name": "World Series 2019",
            "sport": "Baseball",
            "date": "2019-10-28",
            "location": "Dodger Stadium, Los Angeles"
        },
        {
            "name": "NBA Finals 2019",
            "sport": "Basketball",
            "date": "2019-07-08",
            "location": "Staples Center, Los Angeles"
        },
        {
            "name": "UEFA Champions League Final 2019",
            "sport": "Soccer",
            "date": "2019-05-29",
            "location": "Wembley Stadium, London"
        },
        {
            "name": "FIFA Women's World Cup 2019",
            "sport": "Soccer",
            "date": "2019-07-07",
            "location": "Luzhniki Stadium, Moscow"
        }
    ]
